# David Cabeldu

David Cabeldu has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2011 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/david-cabeldu#e15)

  Not elected.

  - [2011 Vote.je Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20111121013843/http://www.vote.je:80/candidates/deputies/st-clement/david-cabeldu)

## Election History

### 2011 Deputies Election

Election for the role of Deputy of [St Clement](https://flow.je/elections/st-clement) (2 seats), 7th September 2011.

**David Cabeldu was not elected**.

| 3 | David Cabeldu |  | 712 | 27.4% |
